name: Academic calendar check
summary: While year, term and session dates are being assembled, your registrar gets a draft calendar with every registration window tied to its term, and every conflicting, missing or out-of-bounds date listed as a question. Nothing is published or changed.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own design, written from its published map of the work of assembling an academic calendar: a unit structure, the date proposals with their versions, and the closed days, each with set column headers; every conflict, gap and overlap shown rather than settled; and every finding turned into a question for the registrar.
